prompt:
You are a senior financial analyst on the Aerospace & Defense team at a mid-market investment bank. The Head of Equity Research has asked you to prepare a quarterly variance analysis of Boeing (BA) to support a research note update following the company's Q1 2026 earnings release. The note will be distributed to institutional clients and must be grounded in verifiable financial data from the latest filings.

Materials provided: The attached spreadsheet contains Boeing's XBRL-sourced financial data for Q1 2026, Q2 2025, Q3 2025, and FY 2025, covering revenue, gross profit, operating income, net income, diluted EPS, R&D expense, total assets, total liabilities, stockholders' equity, and cash balances.

Task requirements:
1. Build a variance analysis workbook with two tabs: one titled 'Quarterly Variance' and one titled 'Balance Sheet Trend'.
2. On the 'Quarterly Variance' tab, create a table comparing Q1 2026 versus Q3 2025 for the following line items: Revenue, Gross Profit, Operating Income (Loss), Net Income (Loss), Diluted EPS, and R&D Expense. For each line item, calculate: (a) Q1 2026 value, (b) Q3 2025 value, (c) absolute variance (Q1 2026 minus Q3 2025), and (d) percentage variance ((Q1 2026 minus Q3 2025) divided by Q3 2025). Use the specific Q3 2025 figures provided in the dataset (the single-period quarterly values). All monetary values must be displayed in millions of dollars; EPS values are displayed as reported.
3. On the 'Balance Sheet Trend' tab, create a table showing Q1 2026, Q2 2025, and Q3 2025 values for Total Assets, Total Liabilities, Stockholders' Equity, and Cash and Cash Equivalents. For Q1 2026, use the Q1 2026 reported figures (not the prior-period comparatives). Calculate Q1 2026 versus Q3 2025 absolute variance and percentage variance for each line item.
4. All percentage variances must be calculated using the formula (Current - Prior) / |Prior|. Format percentages to one decimal place. Format monetary values to one decimal place in millions. Bold all header rows and total/subtotal lines. Right-align all numeric cells.
5. Use the file name 'BA_Q1_2026_Variance_Analysis.xlsx'.

Deliverable: A single Excel workbook (.xlsx) with the two tabs as described above.
